title: Birgitta Böckeler - State of Play: AI Coding Assistants - AI Native DevCon June 2026
description:
Artificial intelligence coding assistants are reshaping the landscape of software development. While they're not magic, their ability to enhance interaction with code demonstrates their revolutionary impact. It's impressive math, not mysticism, that allows these tools to integrate seamlessly into workflows and augment developers' capabilities. 

Birgitta Böckeler, a distinguished engineer at ThoughtWorks, offers her insights into how AI coding innovations of the past year have influenced development practices. With her deep involvement in the AI coding sphere, Birgitta translates potential into practical benefits, drawing from her extensive experience to illuminate how tools like Opus 4.5 and Claude Code are transforming software teams.

What we cover:
• The impact of AI models being stateless.
• The crucial role of context window size in AI coding tools.
• How tool calling affects agentic workflows, especially with powerful models.
• Why are coding harnesses essential for leveraging AI effectively?
• Key shifts in AI coding assistants over the past year.
